description.en: Enables (true) or disables (false) a player's fighting spirit (a flag of the player's record).

true once set, false if the handle is 0.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Enabling a spirit before a match (real usage, from btl0004.nut)
Attaching a spirit (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut, RunAttachAvatarEx)
